title: Word families item 5
instructions: Choose the word-family form that makes the complete sentence grammatical and meaningful.

parts.prompt: The map's ___ improved after the survey team checked every distance twice.

choice_rationales.A: Accurate is an adjective, but the possessive ‘map's’ prepares a noun as the subject.
choice_rationales.B: Accurately is an adverb and cannot be the thing that improved.
choice_rationales.C: Accuracy is the noun named by the possessive and it matches the double-checking evidence.
choice_rationales.D: Accurate enough is an adjective phrase and still cannot serve as the noun subject of improved.

parts.hint: The possessive ‘map's’ identifies something belonging to the map; that thing is the subject of improved.
parts.correct_explanation: The frame requires a noun, so ‘the map's accuracy improved’ is the complete sentence.
